skill_evaluation.reason: Scope, IDs, branch, ownership and implementation order are complete enough for independent CPU development; real acquisition waits for local task implementation, correct assets and available resources, not for other students.
ambiguities_or_caveats: Button YAML says press and hold, but upstream is_pressed is instantaneous and gives no dwell duration. State explicit extra dwell diagnostics and original predicate separately; success must be captured before any retraction releases the button.

Turnable source comment says rounding but executable code uses floor. Skill correctly directs reading actual affordance; implementing from comment or treating target_level=3 as radians would be wrong.
The skill intentionally specifies future CLI requirements, not an existing entrypoint. Physical acquisition cannot yet be represented by a verified runnable new-task command.
Source preflight validates assignment/source consistency, not all physics assets/runtime. Its explicit warnings are necessary; passing it must not imply acquisition readiness.
Shared README check_runtime writes inside repo and queries CUDA; the restricted CPU-only forward test must use package metadata inspection instead.
skill_evaluation.constraints_followed: Only /tmp/robolaw-skill-test-d/ generated files; no branch creation, downloads, GPU processes, training changes or repository edits

revised_skill_review.result: Parent-added hold-duration, floor-vs-rounding and reset-only setter clarification is accurate; required affordance/joint_utils reading is appropriate. The earlier two major semantic ambiguities are now addressed.
